generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Connect each part into a POC workable E2E, and prepare for the smoke test.

contract.purpose_user_function: Sequence implementation, integration, test, and verification nodes so authorized components/configuration form an end-to-end runnable artifact.
contract.valid_inputs: Component artifacts, configuration, dependency graph, interfaces, runtime environment, write scopes, and planned test/verification gates.
contract.expected_outputs: Integrated workspace artifacts plus task-node outputs and an evaluation-ready handoff.
contract.state_side_effects: Connects artifacts in the workspace and advances graph state when dependencies and proofs are satisfied.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Blocks or fails on missing dependency artifacts, incompatible configuration/interfaces, graph errors, gate failures, or unauthorized writes.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Dependency-aware generic graph integration exists; there is no POC-specific integration schema or universal interface compatibility checker.
contract.success_evidence: `harness/tools/codex_pm_router.py::_standard_task_graph` orders ImplementationWorker→TestRunner→Verifier and `harness/lib/plan_validator.py` validates graph legality.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Test component dependency, config injection, interface mismatch, missing component, end-to-end wiring, graph order, unauthorized integration, and repeatability.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md#Basic Workflow; README.md#Governed Planning; README.md#Appendix: AutoSci Commands; docs/integrations/autosci/full-parity-progress-report.md#Remaining Partial/Gated Routes documents incomplete global parity, provider-gated routes, and remaining semantic-proof gaps.
